name: IeWC National Championship
epitaph: Contested in an eight-man tournament in spring 1998, with two first-round matches carried on Wednesday Night WarZone before a champion held it by early summer.

name: IeWC Juniorweight Championship
epitaph: A lighter-weight division title whose tournament opened with Jeff Dallas's win over the veteran favorite Cobra on Wednesday Night WarZone; held by Jinsei Shakanuzi by early summer 1998.

name: IeWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top prize, contested in a spring 1998 tournament; two of its first-round matches aired on Wednesday Night WarZone, with the final billed for Spring Fest 98 that May.

name: IeWC World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Founded in April 1998 when the National Title Tournament's own roster cuts left two teams facing off for the vacant belt; changed hands once more before the promotion's own last surviving broadcast.
